nsw_g7-218n_truck.desc: semi-trailer side view, 942 x 300: the G7-218n plan's own vector artwork (cab, trailer box, four wheels), not traced

notes: TfNSW plan g7-218-1n (TraSiCAD sheet 1:15, text outlined): 900 x 1200 (H x W), Cnr Rad 125, Border '16 x 16' = blue edge 16 + white border 16. P 320 E, top 115 (115 / 320 / 465), 256 wide; numeral 120 E, top 215 (215 / 120 / 565); km 100 E(M), top 235 (235 / 100), 207 wide; truck symbol 942 x 300 at 129 from the left, 505 from the top (235 / 100 / 170 / 300 / 95; 129 / 942 / 129), taken from the plan's vectors. Across: 256 (P) / 299 / 207 (km) with '=' margins, i.e. P from 219, km from 774; the numeral ('*' variable, dashed '2') ends 38 before the unit as drawn and is right-aligned there, so other values keep P and the unit where the plan's example puts them (the plan re-centres the row for other widths; the generated digits differ by a few mm at most). The sheet draws the row 3-5 mm above its own chain (numeral baseline 332, unit baseline 330): the stated figures are used. Values generated: 1, 2, 5 km (the plan's example and the usual advance distances).
